title: Porcelain candling
description: A warm backlight passes through an ivory vessel's thinner walls while the unlit side stays opaque.
useCase: Reveal material thickness and local variation in a craft or product inspection story.
interaction: Drag the backlight across the vessel or use the Backlight slider.
reducedMotion: There is no automatic light motion. Direct input updates the stationary backlight without easing.
limitations: An authored thickness field and exponential absorption approximation, not a physical subsurface-scattering simulation. No textures or models. Requires WebGL 1 with static original SVG fallback and context restoration.
look: An ivory open cup on warm black, localized amber transmitted light and an opaque unlit wall; a compact backlight slider below.
motion: Pointer or slider input moves a light behind the vessel. The transmission term decreases exponentially with local thickness and absorption while the diffuse exterior remains opaque.
adapt: `DEFAULT_CONFIG` and the `config` prop expose wall thickness, backlight radius and absorption. `thicknessField` defines authored variation, `vessel` defines the shell, and `u_lightX`/`u_lightY` hold the onstage light position.
